mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the capillary sprout was most worthwhile: seeing blood flow through the joined vessels made the new supply's purpose clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the new skin cells and then fitting them was a little repetitive, especially with only one combination offered at each point.

surprise.text: Closing the surface did not mean healing was finished; the tissue underneath still needed to gain strength.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt entirely arbitrary. The wound messengers' role was suggested by the picture, though I followed that hint without understanding exactly how they cause vessel growth.

continue.text: I would probably continue: following the wound from a clot to a closed surface and a maturing scar made me curious about how other body processes connect, though the forced steps were less engaging.
